```pddl
(define (problem flood-rescue-medium-01)
  (:domain flood-rescue)

  (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions :action-costs)

  (:objects
    car1 car2 - car
    kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school benighat-farm uttargaya-farm myagang-market
    naukunda-school belkot-farm tadi-school gosaikunda-temple - location
    n1 n2 n3 n4 - level)

  (:init
    (= (total-cost) 0)

    ;; Roads, both directions
    (road benighat-farm uttargaya-farm) (= (travel-time benighat-farm uttargaya-farm) 38)
    (road uttargaya-farm benighat-farm) (= (travel-time uttargaya-farm benighat-farm) 38)

    (road benighat-farm myagang-market) (= (travel-time benighat-farm myagang-market) 54)
    (damaged benighat-farm myagang-market)
    (road myagang-market benighat-farm) (= (travel-time myagang-market benighat-farm) 54)
    (damaged myagang-market benighat-farm)

    (road tarkeshwar-school naukunda-school) (= (travel-time tarkeshwar-school naukunda-school) 17)
    (road naukunda-school tarkeshwar-school) (= (travel-time naukunda-school tarkeshwar-school) 17)

    (road myagang-market naukunda-school) (= (travel-time myagang-market naukunda-school) 29)
    (road naukunda-school myagang-market) (= (travel-time naukunda-school myagang-market) 29)

    (road tarkeshwar-school benighat-farm) (= (travel-time tarkeshwar-school benighat-farm) 14)
    (road benighat-farm tarkeshwar-school) (= (travel-time benighat-farm tarkeshwar-school) 14)

    (road kakani-shelter naukunda-school) (= (travel-time kakani-shelter naukunda-school) 25)
    (road naukunda-school kakani-shelter) (= (travel-time naukunda-school kakani-shelter) 25)

    (road uttargaya-farm belkot-farm) (= (travel-time uttargaya-farm belkot-farm) 11)
    (damaged uttargaya-farm belkot-farm)
    (road belkot-farm uttargaya-farm) (= (travel-time belkot-farm uttargaya-farm) 11)
    (damaged belkot-farm uttargaya-farm)

    (road tarkeshwar-school tadi-school) (= (travel-time tarkeshwar-school tadi-school) 7)
    (damaged tarkeshwar-school tadi-school)
    (road tadi-school tarkeshwar-school) (= (travel-time tadi-school tarkeshwar-school) 7)
    (damaged tadi-school tarkeshwar-school)

    (road gosaikunda-temple uttargaya-farm) (= (travel-time gosaikunda-temple uttargaya-farm) 5)
    (road uttargaya-farm gosaikunda-temple) (= (travel-time uttargaya-farm gosaikunda-temple) 5)

    (road benighat-farm tadi-school) (= (travel-time benighat-farm tadi-school) 21)
    (road tadi-school benighat-farm) (= (travel-time tadi-school benighat-farm) 21)

    (road kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school) (= (travel-time kakani-shelter tarkeshwar-school) 12)
    (road tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter) (= (travel-time tarkeshwar-school kakani-shelter) 12)

    ;; Evacuation points
    (evac-point kakani-shelter)

    ;; Cars
    (car-at car1 kakani-shelter)
    (free-seats car1 n4)
    (carrying car1 injured n0)
    (carrying car1 child n0)
    (carrying car1 elderly n0)
    (carrying car1 adult n0)

    (car-at car2 kakani-shelter)
    (free-seats car2 n4)
    (carrying car2 injured n0)
    (carrying car2 child n0)
    (carrying car2 elderly n0)
    (carrying car2 adult n0)

    ;; People waiting
    (waiting myagang-market adult n4)
    (waiting benighat-farm adult n4)
    (waiting tarkeshwar-school injured n4)
    (waiting tarkeshwar-school child n1)
    (waiting belkot-farm adult n2)
    (waiting naukunda-school child n3)

    ;; Level arithmetic: (sum a b c) means a + b = c
    (sum n0 n0 n0) (sum n0 n1 n1) (sum n0 n2 n2) (sum n0 n3 n3) (sum n0 n4 n4)
    (sum n1 n0 n1) (sum n1 n1 n2) (sum n1 n2 n3) (sum n1 n3 n4)
    (sum n2 n0 n2) (sum n2 n1 n3) (sum n2 n2 n4)
    (sum n3 n0 n3) (sum n3 n1 n4)
    (sum n4 n0 n4)

    (positive n1) (positive n2) (positive n3) (positive n4)

    ;; Deferral penalties: per-person penalty x N
    ;; injured 80, child 60, elderly 50, adult 20
    (= (defer-cost injured n1) 80)
    (= (defer-cost injured n2) 160)
    (= (defer-cost injured n3) 240)
    (= (defer-cost injured n4) 320)

    (= (defer-cost child n1) 60)
    (= (defer-cost child n2) 120)
    (= (defer-cost child n3) 180)
    (= (defer-cost child n4) 240)

    (= (defer-cost elderly n1) 50)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n2) 100)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n3) 150)
    (= (defer-cost elderly n4) 200)

    (= (defer-cost adult n1) 20)
    (= (defer-cost adult n2) 40)
    (= (defer-cost adult n3) 60)
    (= (defer-cost adult n4) 80)
  )

  (:goal (and
    ;; Everyone waiting is rescued or deferred
    (waiting myagang-market adult n0)
    (waiting benighat-farm adult n0)
    (waiting tarkeshwar-school injured n0)
    (waiting tarkeshwar-school child n0)
    (waiting belkot-farm adult n0)
    (waiting naukunda-school child n0)

    ;; Cars end with no passengers on board
    (carrying car1 injured n0)
    (carrying car1 child n0)
    (carrying car1 elderly n0)
    (carrying car1 adult n0)
    (carrying car2 injured n0)
    (carrying car2 child n0)
    (carrying car2 elderly n0)
    (carrying car2 adult n0)
  ))

  (:metric minimize (total-cost))
)
```
